basic_details.job_title: VNMKV Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 2 Senior Research Fellow, Young Professional Posts
basic_details.short_information: The Cotton Research Scheme of Vasantrao Naik Marathwada Krishi Vidyapeeth (VNMKV), Parbhani is filling one Senior Research Fellow (SRF) post at Rs. 37000 + HRA per month and one Young Professional-1 (YP-I) post at Rs. 30000/- fixed per month, on a purely contractual basis under the project "Mission for Cotton Productivity (Kapas Kanti) - 6.1: Dissemination of Pink Bollworm Management Strategies", up to 31 March 2027. age_limit.details: The age limit printed in the notice is minimum 21 years and maximum 45 years, with age relaxation as per rules. The notice does not print a cut-off date for counting age, and it does not list category-wise relaxation figures. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

how_to_apply: Fill in the application in the enclosed proforma, Annexure-I (Application Format for the position of Senior Research Fellow/Young Professional I), which is part of the notification.
Attach a self-attested copy of all required documents.
If you are eligible for both posts and want to apply for both, prepare a separate application for each post.
Submit the application in person at the office of the Cotton Research Scheme, Vasantrao Naik Marathwada Krishi Vidyapeeth, Parbhani on or before 13 November 2026.
A photograph, the name of the project and the name of the post.
Full name, correspondence address, date of birth, mobile number and email ID.
Educational qualifications: exam name, university/board, year of passing, percentage/C.G.P.A and division/class.
Experience details: post, duration (from, up to, total), name of the office, pay/scale and details of work done.
Title of thesis submitted, and publications (research articles, extension articles, television/radio programmes) and others.
Place, date, signature and candidate's name.
important_instructions: Any candidate found to have submitted false claims during screening or at a later stage will have the candidature rejected. Canvassing in any form will lead to disqualification; a shortlisted candidate who canvasses will not be interviewed by the panel. Non-maintenance of discipline and failure to perform the assigned duties will make the SRF and YP-I liable for termination during the appointment period as per rules.

content_sections.heading: VNMKV Recruitment 2026 at a Glance
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the application fee.

rows.details: Vasantrao Naik Marathwada Krishi Vidyapeeth, Parbhani (Cotton Research Scheme)
Mission for Cotton Productivity (Kapas Kanti) - 6.1: Dissemination of Pink Bollworm Management Strategies
Centrally sponsored scheme on Mission for Cotton Productivity (Kapas Kanti) with ICAR-CICR, Nagpur
Up to 31st March 2027 or till termination of the project, whichever is earlier
Minimum 21 years and Maximum 45 years, with age relaxation as per rules
Offline – in person at the Cotton Research Scheme office

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notice announces 2 posts in total, both under the same project. The notice does not give a category-wise break-up of the posts.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The experience listed for each post is desirable, not essential. The notice does not ask for NET or GATE for either post. The age limit printed in the notice is minimum 21 years and maximum 45 years, with age relaxation as per rules. The notice does not print a cut-off date for counting age, and it does not list category-wise relaxation figures. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

rows.desirable_experience: Working experience in research, field experimentation, or pest management in cotton

rows.essential_qualification: Bachelor's Degree in Agriculture or Diploma in Agriculture
rows.desirable_experience: Working experience in cultivation, field operations, or pest management in cotton

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Senior Research Fellow: consolidated pay of Rs. 37000 per month plus HRA. Young Professional-1: Rs. 30000/- fixed per month. Tenure: up to 31 March 2027 or till termination of the project, whichever is earlier. Both positions are purely temporary, filled on contractual basis, co-terminus with the project, and of a time-bound, non-regular nature. Selected candidates will not be entitled to claim regular appointment or absorption in the University or the State Government.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for VNMKV Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Fill in the application in the enclosed proforma, Annexure-I (Application Format for the position of Senior Research Fellow/Young Professional I), which is part of the notification. Attach a self-attested copy of all required documents. If you are eligible for both posts and want to apply for both, prepare a separate application for each post. Submit the application in person at the office of the Cotton Research Scheme, Vasantrao Naik Marathwada Krishi Vidyapeeth, Parbhani on or before 13 November 2026. A photograph, the name of the project and the name of the post. Full name, correspondence address, date of birth, mobile number and email ID. Educational qualifications: exam name, university/board, year of passing, percentage/C.G.P.A and division/class. Experience details: post, duration (from, up to, total), name of the office, pay/scale and details of work done. Title of thesis submitted, and publications (research articles, extension articles, television/radio programmes) and others. Place, date, signature and candidate's name.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Applications will be screened and shortlisted candidates will be informed by email, WhatsApp or a personal phone call to appear for the interview. The interview date and venue are not specified in the notice. Original documents will be verified at the time of interview. Shortlisted candidates must carry their recent bio-data in the enclosed formats along with the originals of the relevant documents. No TA/DA will be borne by the Institute for attending the interview.

rows.event: Last date to submit application (in person)

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Any candidate found to have submitted false claims during screening or at a later stage will have the candidature rejected. Canvassing in any form will lead to disqualification; a shortlisted candidate who canvasses will not be interviewed by the panel. Non-maintenance of discipline and failure to perform the assigned duties will make the SRF and YP-I liable for termination during the appointment period as per rules.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in VNMKV Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 2 posts: 1 Senior Research Fellow and 1 Young Professional-1 in the Cotton Research Scheme, VNMKV, Parbhani.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The application must be submitted in person at the Cotton Research Scheme office, VNMKV, Parbhani on or before 13 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for the VNMKV Senior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: The SRF needs a Master's Degree in Agricultural Entomology; working experience in research, field experimentation, or pest management in cotton is desirable.

faq.question: Q4. What qualification is needed for the Young Professional-1 post?
faq.answer: The YP-I needs a Bachelor's Degree in Agriculture or a Diploma in Agriculture; working experience in cultivation, field operations, or pest management in cotton is desirable.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The notice gives a minimum of 21 years and a maximum of 45 years, with age relaxation as per rules.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for the SRF and YP-I posts?
faq.answer: The Senior Research Fellow gets Rs. 37000 per month plus HRA, and the Young Professional-1 gets Rs. 30000/- fixed per month.

faq.question: Q7. Is HRA paid on top of the pay?
faq.answer: HRA is paid on top of Rs. 37000 only for the Senior Research Fellow; the Young Professional-1 pay of Rs. 30000/- is fixed per month.

faq.question: Q8. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Fill in the Annexure-I proforma, attach self-attested copies of all required documents, and submit it in person at the Cotton Research Scheme office, VNMKV, Parbhani by 13 November 2026.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: Shortlisted candidates will be called for an interview by email, WhatsApp or phone call, and original documents will be verified at the interview.

faq.question: Q10. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. Both posts are purely temporary and contractual, co-terminus with the project, up to 31 March 2027 or till the project ends, whichever is earlier, with no claim to regular appointment.
